abilities.name: water-absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: damp
abilities.effect: Prevents self destruct, explosion, and aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

kanto.flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

original-johto.flavorText: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.

hoenn.flavorText: It is possible to see this POKéMON’s spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

updated-johto.flavorText: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

original-unova.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

kalos.flavorText: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

original-alola.flavorText: It’s still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

updated-alola.flavorText: The direction of the swirl on their stomachs differs depending on where they live. Poliwag aficionados can tell them apart at a glance.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

swsh.flavorText: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
